title: Nam Bak cement-plant workers’ unpaid-wage gathering
reason: Provisional exclusion under the private-dispute rule: the gathering is reported outside the private plant owner’s home and as a demand for unpaid wages from the owner; no state-directed demand at the gathering is documented in the currently available reporting. Earlier complaints to labor authorities are distinct acts, so target eligibility remains uncertain.
notes: The two reports are from the same RFA reporting chain, not independent confirmation. They report around 100 workers at the gathering. S001 describes prior repeated requests and written complaints to district/provincial labor offices and the Ministry of Labor and Social Welfare in early February; that earlier contact does not establish the gathering’s target. S002 reports a later April mediation committee that included a district labor representative and payment of back wages. The gathering is retained for review because its domestic-state target is not fully resolved; if a direct government demand at the event is verified, recode it as a pending candidate. Exact home address, organizers, duration, and physical end are not established.
